legend: Given a constraint array A%%ZSMJ0%% of length N%%ZSMJ1%%, we generate a new integer array B%%ZSMJ2%% of length N%%ZSMJ3%% satisfying the following conditions:
All elements of B%%ZSMJ4%% are positive, i.e. Bi>0%%ZSMJ5%%
The last element of B%%ZSMJ10%%, i.e. BN%%ZSMJ11%% here is minimum possible.
Let f(A)%%ZSMJ12%% denote the minimum possible value of the last element of B%%ZSMJ13%% for a valid array B%%ZSMJ14%%.

You will be given queries L%%ZSMJ15%% and R%%ZSMJ16%%, and you need to answer f(A[L,R])%%ZSMJ17%% where A[L,R]%%ZSMJ18%% denotes the subarray [AL,AL+1,...,AR]%%ZSMJ19%%. That is, you need to answer the minimum value of the last element of B%%ZSMJ20%% possible if only the L%%ZSMJ21%%-th to the R%%ZSMJ22%%-th indices of A%%ZSMJ23%% were present.
There are multiple test cases in each file, and thus you will be given an input parameter T%%ZSMJ24%%, denoting that you have to solve T%%ZSMJ25%% test cases.
input: The first line of input contains T%%ZSMJ26%% - the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains N%%ZSMJ27%% and Q%%ZSMJ28%% - the size of the array A%%ZSMJ29%% and the number of queries respectively.
The second line of each test case contains N%%ZSMJ30%% integers - A1,A2,...,AN%%ZSMJ31%%
The j%%ZSMJ32%%-th of the next Q%%ZSMJ33%% lines contains Lj%%ZSMJ34%% and Rj%%ZSMJ35%% - the parameters of the j%%ZSMJ36%%-th query.
output: For each test case, output Q%%ZSMJ37%% integers on a single line, f(A[Lj,Rj])%%ZSMJ38%% for each query.
The sum of N%%ZSMJ43%% and the sum of Q%%ZSMJ44%% over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105%%ZSMJ45%%
The special constraint whole array means that Q=1,L1=1,R1=N%%ZSMJ46%%, i.e. there is only one query which covers the whole array.
Subtask 1 (4 points) : N=2%%ZSMJ47%% and whole array
Subtask 2 (15 points) : N≤1000%%ZSMJ48%%, whole array, and the sum of N%%ZSMJ49%% over all test cases does not exceed 1000%%ZSMJ50%%
Subtask 6 (20 points) : Rj=N%%ZSMJ53%% for all queries
note: Test Case 1 : This is a query on the whole array. A=[2,1]%%ZSMJ54%% and we choose B=[1,2]%%ZSMJ55%% which satisfies all conditions, while minimizing the last element value of 2%%ZSMJ56%%. It can be proven it is impossible to achieve a smaller value.

Test Case 2 : In the first query, the query is again of the whole array, A=[1,2,3,4]%%ZSMJ57%% and we choose B=[5,5,5,5]%%ZSMJ58%% which satisfies all conditions and minimizes the last element value of 5%%ZSMJ59%%.
In the second query, we work with the subarray A=[2,3,4]%%ZSMJ60%% instead, and we can choose B=[1,1,1]%%ZSMJ61%% here.
